zaira.routing.purpose: list the categories by group, with counts and what each holds

description:
List all categories (topics), grouped by area, with the number of entries in each and a line on what each holds. A topic holds every kind of entry that does its job: tools and services, libraries, programming languages (the "language" category). The list is also the map of what the guide covers: a kind of tool newer than your training data has a category here whose line says what it does.

Returns: a first line with the totals, then each group as a "## heading" (AI coding, Building AI apps and agents, Databases and data, ...) followed by one line per category in slug order: "category_slug: N tools | what the category holds". A topic that also holds libraries or languages counts each kind, "category_slug: 3 tools, 2 libraries | ...". The heading is a label in this list only: filter zaira_search_tools by category slug, and by kind to see one kind within a topic.

Example call: no parameters.

Edge cases:
- Categories with zero tools do not appear in the output.
- Category slugs are lowercase-alphanumeric with hyphens (e.g., "relational-database", "vector-database", "frontend-framework", "mcp-server"). They may differ from casual category names — the slug form is canonical.

Risk: read-only, closed-world, idempotent — no state change possible.
name: zaira_list_categories
